data.text:
Syed Sohel Syed Mehmood vs The Commissioner Of Police
Aurangabad ... on 15 May, 2024 
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 734 Of 2024
 Syed Sohel Syed Mehmood
 Versus
 The Commissioner Of Police Aurangabad And Another
Mr. A. R. Borulkar, Advocate for the Applicant
Mr. V. M. Kagane, App for the Respondents/State
 Coram : R. M. Joshi, J.
 (Vacation Court)
 Dated : 15th May, 2024
Per Court :-
1. Heard.
2.  Issue notice to the respondents, returnable on 14th June,
2024. Learned APP waives service of notice for respondent Nos.1 and 2/State.
3. The learned counsel for the applicant submits that the contraband articles i.e. gutkha, panmasala are already seized and nothing is to be recovered at the instance of the Applicant. He further submits, on instructions, that the Applicant has no criminal history. 
4. Having regard to these facts, liberty of the Applicant is protected till the prosecution is heard in the matter. Hence, the 28.aba734.24.odt 1 of 2  following order:- 
 ORDER Syed Sohel Syed Mehmood vs The Commissioner Of Police Aurangabad ... on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103114054/ 
1 (i) Till the next date, in the event of arrest of applicant in connection with Crime No. 0025/2024,
registered with Jinsi Police Station, Dist. Aurangabad for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 273, 188 of IPC, 26(1), 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(d), 27(3)(e), 30(2)
(a), 59 of Food Safety and Standard Act and 7(2) of the Cigarette and other Tobacco Products (Prohibition on Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, he shall be released on bail on furnishing PR Bond of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount. 
(ii) He shall attend the concerned police station once in a week. 
(iii) He shall not contact the witnesses directly or indirectly. 
(iv) He shall not interfere with the evidence in any manner whatsoever. 
(v) He is further directed to cooperate the investigating agency for further investigation. 
(vi) Learned APP to communicate this order to concerned Police Station. 
(R. M. JOSHI, J.) ssp 28.aba734.24.odt 2 of 2 Syed Sohel Syed Mehmood vs The Commissioner Of Police Aurangabad ... on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103114054/
